tagline: A dedicated space for your team's work.
windowBenefit: Open from your home screen or dock in its own window.
accountBenefit: Your account, projects and theme stay with you.
connectionBenefit: An internet connection is needed to load and save work.
installed: Workloom is installed. Open it from your home screen or app launcher.
iosInstructions: On iPhone or iPad, open Workloom in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Keep Open as Web App enabled if offered.
browserInstructions: On desktop or Android, open your browser menu and look for Install app or Add to Home Screen. Availability depends on your browser.
installFailed: Installation could not be opened. Try your browser's Install app menu instead.
offlineNotice: You're offline. Reconnect to load and save changes.
